# Awesome Magento AEO

> A curated list of modules, specifications and tools that make a Magento 2 or Adobe Commerce store discoverable, readable and transactable by AI systems. Covers llms.txt generation, AI crawler policy, structured data, ACP product feeds, agentic checkout, MCP servers and AEO auditing.

Maintained by angeo.dev. Covers free and commercial projects, each listed once in the section closest to its primary purpose. Entries maintained by angeo.dev are placed last within their section and disclosed in the readme.

Last reviewed 2026-08. Licensed CC0.

## Core

- [Readme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/README.md): The full list, organised by function, with a routing guide from problem to section.
- [Comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/COMPARISON.md): Capability coverage per project as a table — llms.txt, crawler policy, structured data, feeds, checkout, MCP, auditing — with each project's self-declared maturity status.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Scope, inclusion criteria and entry format.

## Optional

- [Code of conduct](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angeo-dev/awesome-magento-aeo/main/code-of-conduct.md): Community standards, including the rule on competitor entries.
